title: Latvian honorary consulate building in Sloviansk destroyed by Russian strike
summary_full: On Friday, July 24th, Russia carried out an airstrike on the city of Sloviansk in Ukraine's Donetsk region, which destroyed the building of the Latvian honorary consulate.
